[h1]打牌不是关键，排序排出爆炸伤害才是硬道理。 [/h1] [h1]前言： [/h1] 《Runeveil》作为一款卡牌肉鸽游戏，整体玩法不再是传统的一张一张打出手牌，而是通过不同牌型的效果，搭配丰富的上古遗物以及附魔药水，合理安排自己牌型的顺序，不断增加联动倍率，使辅助牌型与战斗牌型相辅相成，从而打出超高伤害一击打倒敌人。 [h1]游戏内容： [/h1] 游戏当中我们现在可以有四个角色选择，每个角色的能力各不相同，比如火焰法师我们是可以燃烧自己，然后通过燃烧层数增加护盾血量以及对敌人造成额外伤害。还有自然法师、奥术师等。选择好角色之后我们可以进入竞技场页面，那里一共有七大场景，需要逐步解锁，然后击败各层罪恶之王，获得不同的超强BUFF。 游玩过程中我们使用的卡牌倍率也会显示在卡牌的右下角上，逐步触发符文效果的时候我们也可以在屏幕中央直观地看到累计的伤害，当你前期看到好多位数伤害被轰的一拳打出去的时候，真的很有一拳超人的感觉，直接把卡牌游戏玩成可以秒人的爽游。当然游戏的难度也是慢慢递增的，后期想要稳操胜券也要整理好已拥有牌型，把多余的移除卡组，还有通过达成一些条件来使得卡牌解锁，比如刚好获得一万护盾之类的，如此下来，你才能在排序中有更高的概率得到你想要的效果。 游戏地图方面也是传统的手动点击移动到下一关，不同的是地图上每一关会有两个获胜奖励供你选择，比如现在你是更需要金币还是更好的符文奖励亦或是要移除卡牌，都可以在进图前决定，地图外游戏角色也会有成长，在对局当中获得的经验就可以升级他们的天赋树。 [h1]总结： [/h1] 本作是一款玩法比较创新的卡通风格游戏，通过对卡牌符文顺序的抉择，以及上古遗物发挥出的作用，还有不同角色的能力，彼此相互循环，不断增加着倍率，让攻击指数在屏幕上不断攀升，然后打出超越敌人血量的一击，直接终结比赛。若你是一个对卡牌构筑游戏感兴趣的玩家，那么不妨体验下这种玩法。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

I was a little hesitant to get this because it looked like it might have some common issues that pop up sometimes with indies but it ended up being surprisingly good. 10 hours of play went by shockingly fast. I'll write up a proper review later when I have more time but I just wanted to get this in early since it's deserved.

short version: I love the freedom this game gives on how you can build your deck because I love experimenting with janky decks in any deck building game. Overall: A nice roguelike deck builder with a twist on its damage system. There is a great load of variety between runs with random rewards after each fight and the different cards of each element. The dual element system also allows players to combine different mechanics unique to each color (like MtG) which I really like.

As a weirdo whose favorite subject was mathematics, I am EXTREMELY happy. I've been playing Runeveil since the demo days, and the Early Access has only made me more excited for the full launch. There is a lot of content both for competitive players and more casuals. Whether you're looking for a challenge or a relaxed experience, you can find the difficulty that suits you. Also the art is very cute. Everytime nature wizard takes a hit it hurts my soul... Great deck-builder!

I'm not usually a huge fan of card games, but this one completely changed my mind. The gameplay loop is engaging and the art style is great. Played for over 4 hours and I'm already hooked. Great potential!

An excellent deckbuilder with solid variety between classes and a variety of synergies within each class to build around. I enjoy the sequencing aspect of the game, which is that you need to arrange your 5 card hand to be played in a specific order from left to right. All of the cards in your hand are played each turn and I am a sucker for mana-less card systems. It's complex enough that it creates a lot of engagement while not being so hard to understand that you constantly feel like you're making misplays each turn. My personal experience with the game that really hooked me was just how much power there is in mid-run and late-run cards and artifacts. If you can survive about half way through a run and land the right card or item, you can snowball into some neat stuff. Also, the ability to mix deck types in the middle of a run adds a neat complexity that other games don't have. After beating the first area of a run you can decide to stay with your deck type (i.e. if you chose the fire wizard, you can choose to stick with fire only spells) or you can choose to start seeing cards from other characters in your shops. I can only imagine what crazy builds you can make from this seeing as I already have so much to explore and learn about how to build good decks while sticking with one element only. Fans of the genre will find a lot to love here.

Really fun and surprisingly well-balanced card game. Every class feels unique and offers different ways to play, and the card pool is large enough that no two runs feel the same. I love how many different strategies and deck-building paths are available. Easy to get into, but with plenty of depth to keep things interesting. Definitely worth checking out!

Fun game! Runeveil is similar to Balatro with a flat damage and damage multiplier component accrued from runes (cards) and artifacts (jokers). However, combat is much more fleshed out and similar to Slay the Spire with enemy intents, shielding, various status effects, and auras (powers). I'm looking forward to seeing this game develop towards a full-release.

This is a fun and addictive card drafting that keeps pulling me back for "just one more run". The different mages come with their distinct playstyles that fundamentally changes how you approach drafting, combat, and resource management. The ascension system is another highlight that challenges your understanding of the game's mechanics. Higher ascension levels don't simply inflate enemy stats—they challenge you from different angles and push you to adapt your strategies. Climbing through the ascensions feels rewarding because success comes from improving your decision-making and game knowledge. Recommended if you like to draft and figure out the "meta" (but without any mana screw problems).
Nice. Fun game. Good replayability. Active devs. It's own thang, but a cozy, familiar vibe. Great stuff!
First two mages were fun, didn't enjoy the second two. Didn't get my money's worth for 3.7 hours of play. Wish I could refund because it didn't feel very replayable.

《runeveil》是一款画风独特的Rougelike牌组构筑策略游戏。我们将扮演符文法师，操控流派构筑、对敌策略不尽相同的四位属性法师，号令『火焰』、『自然』、『神秘』与『冰霜』之力，调整抽上手的卡牌位置、将符文按特定序列摆好，然后就等着看它们像多米诺骨牌一般连锁触发、造成毁灭性的巨额伤害吧！能力各异的元素符文、力量强大的上古神器，以及施加增益的药水与卷轴……在难度递增的竞技场中证明我们的实力！ 游戏的上手门槛并不高，过完小丑Kloki的新手教程，我们就可以大杀四方啦！实际体验下来，本作的玩法和《小丑牌》有些相似——同样靠打出滚雪球一般的高额伤害（分数）来通关，同样可以弃牌以寻找更优解。但《runeveil》的特殊之处在于，比起“牌是什么/打出了什么”，本作更依赖“牌的顺序”来得分——这也就意味着，哪怕是一手平平无奇的符文，也可以通过排列组合的方式清空敌人的血条。以最初的火焰法师为例，符文可分为攻击与辅助两大类，而部分符文置于特定位置时还能提升效果/获得成长！不过并不是所有符文都是如此——以【陨石打击】（谁家鸡煲）为例，虽然它拥有高达250点分数和0.70的倍率，但【终结】的词条意味着无论位于何处，当它触发时便会强制结束我们的回合。此外，敌人也拥有各式各样的能力，有的会恢复最大生命值，有的则对我们的“重抽”进行限制，需要有针对性地进行应对。 总体而言，《runeveil》是一款画风优秀的同时也质量在线的作品，期待后续更新带来更多新的可玩角色～ [quote]欢迎前来关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45353266/] 𝗞𝗼𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗮𝗼🍁」 [/url] [u][b] 采撷旅途之叶，铭刻生命之诗[/b][/u][/quote]

In short: Runeveil is a polished, creative, and highly replayable deckbuilder with satisfying mechanics, great build variety, and developers who clearly care about the game and its community. Runeveil is a genuinely impressive deckbuilder, especially for an Early Access game. The different characters and deck types feel distinct, and there are plenty of interesting synergies to experiment with. I especially enjoy the card-ordering mechanic, as it adds an extra layer of strategy and makes every turn feel more engaging. The game gives you a lot of freedom when building your deck. You can remove cards you no longer need, focus on specific combinations, or mix different deck types during a run to create some really fun and unexpected builds. It feels balanced enough that many different strategies can work, which makes each run feel fresh. There are still a few minor bugs and some mechanics may take a run or two to fully understand, but the developers are very active, responsive, and clearly care about player feedback. The game already feels surprisingly polished and offers great value for its price. If you enjoy roguelike deckbuilders such as Slay the Spire, but want something with its own identity and mechanics, Runeveil is definitely worth trying. I started playing just to check it out and ended up losing track of time. I’m really excited to see how it grows.
